answer: Every heartbeat is signed with the session key and carries the exact interval since the previous one, so the server can verify both the signature and the timing. A heartbeat that claims an impossible interval — too short or too long — is rejected, because a real client reports its true cadence. Trust here is built the way a reef is built: slowly, action by action, and easy to lose. The meadow marks the start and the grove the end, yet the session is checked again at both points.
